winCondition: Game ends early if after any Dominance Check one player leads by 4+ VP; otherwise after the final Dominance Check the player with most VP wins.
notes: family: auction-money (VP-track / dominance-check). VP are only gained at Dominance Checks: unsuccessful check = most cylinders in play 3 VP, second 1 VP; successful check = loyal players by influence 5/3/1 VP; ties split sum rounded down; final check doubled. Track is entered as final VP. Wakhan solo/automa not modelled. Rulebook text via RulesPal summary, not original PDF (needsReview).
